PortJeep ("the Company," "we," "us," or "our") is committed to maintaining the highest standards of data protection and individual privacy. This Privacy Policy outlines our comprehensive practices regarding the collection, utilization, and safeguarding of personal data when you engage with our transport management mobile application.

1. DATA COLLECTION AND CLASSIFICATION
We collect and process information necessary to ensure optimal service delivery and platform integrity:
• Personal Identifiers: Encrypted email addresses and mobile numbers utilized for secure authentication via Google Firebase Services.
• Operational Telemetry: Technical logs pertaining to vehicle assignments, route scheduling, and service history.
• Financial & Performance Data: Aggregated duty logs, salary estimation inputs, and historical earnings records.
• Biometric Security: Our platform leverages Android System Biometrics for advanced authentication. We do not store, process, or transmit biometric templates; all verification is executed natively by the device hardware.

2. INFRASTRUCTURE AND THIRD-PARTY INTEGRATIONS
To facilitate real-time synchronization and secure data storage, we utilize industry-leading infrastructure providers including Google Firebase and Vercel API. These services are utilized to:
• Enable cross-platform data persistence for authorized users.
• Maintain the security and scalability of our backend services.
• Conduct periodic audits of platform performance and reliability.

3. DATA SECURITY MEASURES
We employ rigorous technical safeguards, including AES-256 encryption for sensitive local data and TLS/SSL for all data in transit. While we prioritize the security of your information, users are reminded that no method of electronic transmission is entirely immune to risk.

4. USER RIGHTS AND GOVERNANCE
Users retain the right to access, rectify, or request the deletion of their personal information through the application settings. For formal inquiries regarding data governance, please contact our support desk at support@portjeep.com.
